verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents an official `humanlayer` CLI. `humanlayer automation run` launches Cloud-visible coding sessions from CI, cron or scripts, and the docs cover installing, authenticating and launching a remote daemon, with launch tokens for non-interactive commands. The documented scope is narrow, though: only automation runs and daemon setup are shown, and the main task workflow centres on the macOS and web apps. missing for 10: a full CLI command reference covering tasks, sessions and review, CLI-driven task management beyond automation and daemon launch, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server.
This guide shows you how to install, authenticate, and launch a remote daemon.
Use a launch token for one non-interactive command.
